plugins.description: SBrain: one command, skiddle-mode, that makes your coding agent plan, build, and verify like a careful senior engineer. Forked from Lauren Tan's pstack. Runs in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and more, with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Go, Rust, Ruby, and PHP built in.
